title: Extend benchmark harness with pluggable eval runners and prompt/dataset schema
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Improve the benchmark harness used to generate performance profiles for onboarding and publishing models. Goals: (1) design a pluggable eval-runner API to support different evaluation types (generation, classification, embeddings, retrieval), (2) standardize dataset and prompt schema to guarantee reproducible runs and minimize manual preprocessing, (3) add deterministic seeding, fixture-based inputs, and exact-metrics output compatible with the profile publisher, (4) integrate runners into CI and artifact pipeline so profiles are generated and validated pre-publish. This ticket focuses on infra + schema and a lightweight reference runner for text-generation and multiple-choice evals.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New eval-runner interface documented and implemented with at least two reference runners (text-generation and classification). 2) Dataset schema (CSV/JSONL) and prompt templating format defined; existing benchmark datasets converted to schema examples. 3) Harness can produce deterministic metric bundles (latency distribution, token-level memory, BLEU/ROUGE/EM/Accuracy where applicable) and a normalized perf-profile JSON that the profile publisher accepts. 4) CI job added to run a smoke profile on PRs and fail on regression thresholds. 5) Backwards compatibility check confirms existing profiles still ingestable or conversion utility included.
tasks: Define runner interface (input spec, lifecycle hooks, metrics API)
Design dataset + prompt schema document and examples
Implement reference text-generation runner with prefix/KV cache toggles
Add deterministic RNG/seeding + fixture runner mode
Hook harness into existing artifact store and profile publisher
Create CI smoke job and threshold-based gating
Write migration script for legacy benchmark artifacts
